Welcome to Reviving Veterinary Medicine, founded by Dr. Marie Holowaychuk to improve the mental health and wellbeing of veterinary professionals worldwide. After experiencing burnout and transforming her life through self-care and mindfulness, Dr. Marie committed to helping others navigate similar challenges.

What You’ll Find on Our Channel
🎙️ Podcast Episodes – Monologues and interviews with experts.
📹 YouTube Shorts – Quick insights and tips.
🧘 Guided Meditations – Mindfulness practices for enhancing wellness.
💻 Webinars – Evidence-based strategies for wellbeing and mental health.

Our Mission
To empower veterinary professionals with tools and knowledge that promote sustainable careers and healthier workplaces.

Join Us
Subscribe for inspiring content that helps you thrive—personally and professionally. Together, we can create a more healthy and sustainable veterinary profession.
